description: Defines the GeneralAggregateFunc class, a Java implementation of an aggregate function used within Spark SQL connector expressions, supporting various SQL aggregate functions with properties like function name, distinct flag, children expressions, and ordering within groups.

classes.name: GeneralAggregateFunc
classes.description: A class representing a general SQL aggregate function with properties such as name, distinct flag, input expressions, and optional ordering within groups, supporting various aggregate functions like VAR_POP, STDDEV_SAMP, COVAR_POP, etc.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the aggregate function.

methods.name: isDistinct
methods.description: Returns whether the aggregate function is marked as DISTINCT.

methods.name: children
methods.description: Returns the input expressions for the aggregate function.

methods.name: orderingWithinGroups
methods.description: Returns the ordering specifications within groups for the aggregate function.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare GeneralAggregateFunc instances based on name, isDistinct, children, and orderingWithinGroups.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode to generate a hash based on name, isDistinct, children, and orderingWithinGroups.
